description: A React component for managing channel members in the Mattermost admin console, including listing users, filtering, searching, and adding/removing members.

classes.name: ChannelMembers
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing members of a specific channel in the admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data loading when the component mounts, including channel stats and user profiles.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to filters or search term, triggering profile reloads or searches.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of channel members.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Callback to remove a user from the channel.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Applies filtering options to the user list.
